text_block_list.text: (Plink~♪)

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Hyaa~ splendid! You're already able to play this well?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: To have mastered a piece of such difficulty to this extent. You have my sincere admiration.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Ottimo! Magnificent! —However, there is still a slight hesitation in the sound.

text_block_list.name: Karen Chan
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, you're right! ...It wasn't totally flawless, so Karen would rate it around 40 points, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Karen Chan
text_block_list.text: Um! If there's any spot that felt off to you, could you mark it on the sheet music?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Sì! Of course. But—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Rest comes first! Before your fingers begin to sing a lament.

text_block_list.name: Karen Chan
text_block_list.text: Mm~ what wonderful weather! A cafe sounds nice, but maybe takeout or something—

text_block_list.name: Female Bystander
text_block_list.text: Hey, isn't that the real Curren over there? Her face is so tiny! Super cute Karen Chan!

text_block_list.name: Male Bystander
text_block_list.text: Eh, whoa, for real...?! ...S-So cute. She's literally cuteness incarnate.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Even casual passersby are fans. As expected of an Umastagrammer with 3 million followers.

text_block_list.name: Young Fan Girl
text_block_list.text: Karen-chan, Karen-chan, look! My outfit matches Karen-chan's!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Whoa, incredible! It looks exactly like her racing attire... Could it be handmade by your mother?

text_block_list.name: Girl's Mother
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes! Both mother and daughter are huge fans...!

text_block_list.name: Karen Chan
text_block_list.text: Waaaah! Karen is so, so happy♡ Would you like to take a photo together~?

text_block_list.name: Elderly Gentleman Fan
text_block_list.text: —I've been watching races for a long time, you see. Recently, my grandchild taught me how to support my favorite idols, so I started doing that too.

text_block_list.name: Karen Chan
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much, kind sir! Karen will keep giving it her best from now on too♡

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Che emozione! What a rich and resonant timbre of love...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Truly, across all ages and genders. Karen-san is exceptionally loved.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: And it's 'super' love at that. ...Taken to the extreme, even if all you played on the piano was "Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star," your fans would probably still be overjoyed.

text_block_list.name: Karen Chan
text_block_list.text: Fufu, that's true! Everyone would shower love on Karen no matter what♪

text_block_list.name: Karen Chan
text_block_list.text: ...But that just won't do.

text_block_list.name: Karen Chan
text_block_list.text: Because that would just be taking advantage of their love. Relying on love for the Karen of the past.

text_block_list.name: Karen Chan
text_block_list.text: This time, Karen wants to "give love in return" to everyone. And—

text_block_list.name: Karen Chan
text_block_list.text: Karen's love is about giving everyone the confidence to know that the love they've poured into her was never a mistake.

text_block_list.name: Karen Chan
text_block_list.text: That's why Karen won't take the easy way out.

text_block_list.name: Karen Chan
text_block_list.text: Even if it's difficult, I'm going to play that song which conveys love the best, completely flawlessly...

text_block_list.name: Karen Chan
text_block_list.text: And make everyone fall in love with me all over again, thinking, 'That's our cute Karen-chan for you!!'♪

text_block_list.name: Karen Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Because if I do that, everyone will keep loving Karen for years and years to come♪

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Che musica celestiale! The ensemble of love reverberates across the heavens...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Once more, I, Sounds of Earth, pledge my full cooperation so that you may play your love to the fullest!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Alright! In that case, we'll put even more spirit into supporting you too!
While out running errands, I ran into Karen Chan and the others earnestly browsing through some products.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Yep, yep. For Karen's piano practice. Figured we'd give our hardworking junior a little cheer-up gift~
I nodded in understanding... Since I was here, I decided to look at the items too— What would be good?
choice_data_list: Think carefully and pick on my own

text_block_list.text:
After thinking it over... to keep her fingertips warm,
I picked out a cute pocket hand warmer and gave it to her.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, Trainer-san!
...Curren's heart is feeling all warm now too♡

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Hmm, well then—let's go with this cuticle oil!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I'll put this on... and remember your cheers
while giving practice my very best♪
